source.title: Diagnosis and Treatment of Adults with Community-acquired Pneumonia. An Official Clinical Practice Guideline of the American Thoracic Society and Infectious Diseases Society of America.

whyItFits: ATS/IDSA 2019 CAP guideline criteria that define severe pneumonia, carried forward from the 2007 IDSA/ATS rule.
limitations: Severity criteria from the open ATS/IDSA 2019 guideline. Steroid trials were not used.
